title: Redlock Algorithm for Distributed Locking
short_description: A distributed lock manager algorithm implemented using Redis instances to achieve high availability and mutual exclusion.
trend_reason: Frequently evaluated in senior backend architecture interviews to test understanding of consensus, clock drift, and failure handling in distributed caching systems.

title: ZooKeeper-Based Distributed Locks
short_description: Implementing ephemeral sequential nodes in Apache ZooKeeper to achieve strictly ordered and fault-tolerant distributed locking.
trend_reason: Remains a foundational design pattern in enterprise architectures utilizing CP systems for strict coordination.

title: Event-Driven Architecture with Kafka Compaction
short_description: Using Apache Kafka's log compaction feature to maintain the latest state for each key, merging message queues with database-like state tables.
trend_reason: Essential for modern event-sourced microservices requiring event streaming alongside reliable state persistence.

title: Transactional Outbox Pattern in Message Brokers
short_description: An architectural pattern ensuring reliable message publishing alongside database transactions by utilizing an outbox table and a relay processor.
trend_reason: Crucial for solving dual-write problems in distributed microservices architectures during system design interviews.

title: RabbitMQ Quorum Queues
short_description: A modern queue type in RabbitMQ built on the Raft consensus algorithm to provide high availability and data safety.
trend_reason: Adoption is growing as engineering teams migrate away from classic mirrored queues toward consensus-based queue replication.
